beats.line: If it weren't, you know, Florida. Your deadly
adventure begins with a vertical descent into the water
but very quickly you will encounter your first real challenge
a section called the chimney. This is an incredibly tight squeeze
where you must be extremely careful not to snag the hoses to your tanks
causing them to disconnect from your life support. Once you pass through you'll enter the entrance room
a large open area that splits into two tunnel systems. But of course
for the sake of the video we're heading towards the deepest and deadliest section
here where you'll be greeted with this infamous terrifying sign
warning you to stop and turn back around to prevent your own death
